identity.title: An ALMA CO(2-1) Survey of Nearby Palomar-Green Quasars

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present new ALMA Compact Array observations of the CO(2–1) line for 23 $z<0.1$ Palomar-Green quasars.

question.value: Cold molecular gas properties, excitation, star formation efficiency, and CO-to-H2 conversion factor in nearby quasar host galaxies.

evidence.quote: Are the basic properties of cold gas in quasar host galaxies different from those of inactive galaxies?
Does star formation operate in the same manner as ordinary star-forming galaxies?
Although the scatter is considerable, the current data do not suggest that the CO-to-H$_2$ conversion factor of quasar host galaxies significantly differs from that of normal star-forming galaxies.

The αCO conclusion depends on inherited dust-based total gas masses and assumptions about comparable galaxy populations.
The reported R21 and gas-fraction percentile ranges should not be treated as uncertainties on the population medians.
